extension.summary: Netflix catalogue and playback for your own account
extension.description: SmoothFlix signs in with your Netflix account and plays through inputstream.adaptive and Widevine. Aurora Cinema is the home, title and player screen: near-black, type-led, with artwork loaded by Kodi. A classic directory list is in the settings.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Netflix account. Video is played with Kodi inputstream.adaptive and Widevine. No other sources are used.
extension.news: v0.3.0 (2026-11-19)[CR]- Aurora Cinema home, title page and player overlay.[CR]- Classic directory list remains available in settings.
